about.heroSubtitle:
The future of smart buildings

and the journey of growth that MerlotLab is creating.
about.metaDescription: The future of smart buildings and the journey of growth that MerlotLab is creating.
about.introP1: Beyond Building DX, MerlotLab is preparing for the Building AX era, in which AI operates buildings on its own.
about.introP2: We see the lighting installed throughout a building as its nervous system. By applying our in-house Merlot Mesh to lighting across the entire building, we connect the whole building into a single wireless network.
about.introP3: The wireless infrastructure MerlotLab builds is not limited to any single service. On top of this lighting infrastructure, a wide range of smart building services—energy management, indoor positioning, workplace environment management, security, safety, fire detection, and more—can be continuously expanded on a single platform.
about.introP4: The data accumulated in this process becomes the foundation for AI to understand a building as a single living organism and operate it autonomously. By shifting building operations that once relied on human experience and intuition to a data- and AI-driven autonomous system, MerlotLab aims to realize autonomous smart buildings that sense, decide, and operate on their own.

tech.heroSubtitle: An introduction to Merlot Lab's core technologies.
tech.videoSubtitle: See Merlot Lab's core technologies in a video.
tech.meshSubtitle: Connects the entire building as a single wireless network.
tech.meshDesc1: Conventional smart buildings are built on wired backbones and intermediate hubs, but with Merlot Mesh the lighting itself acts as a network node. Simply installing mesh-enabled lighting builds a 100% wireless mesh network across the whole building — no separate wiring work required.
tech.meshDesc2: This dramatically cuts construction cost and installation time, and lets existing buildings become smart buildings with ease.
tech.floodingSubtitle: Selects the optimal communication path in real time.
tech.floodingDesc1: Each node analyzes link quality and network congestion with its neighbors in real time and decides on its own whether to forward data. Every node is not fixed to one role — depending on network conditions it flexibly acts as a Relay Node or an End Node.
tech.floodingDesc2: Data is delivered simultaneously over multiple paths rather than a single route, and retransmission is optimized based on neighboring nodes' network state. This sustains stable delivery and high scalability even in large networks, realizing a Self-Healing Mesh that maintains the optimal path even when failures occur.
tech.anchorSubtitle: Selects the optimal positioning anchor based on tag location.
tech.anchorDesc1: The Selective Anchor algorithm is Merlot Lab's proprietary location-tracking algorithm that dynamically selects the anchors used for positioning based on tag location.
tech.anchorDesc2: A tag uses beacon signals to select 3–5 nearby anchors, measures the distance to each, and sends the distance data to the server. Based on multiple anchor distances, the server computes the tag's position and displays it in real time on 2D and 3D digital floor plans.

rtls.heroSubtitle: Using a wireless mesh network, check the location of indoor assets and people in real time without building any separate communication infrastructure.

Merlot RTLS is an indoor location-tracking service that checks the real-time location

of assets, moving objects, workers and visitors inside a building

and visualizes movement history and space usage.

Merlot RTLS leverages the Merlot Mesh lighting infrastructure installed for EMS.

Simply adding UWB anchors to the existing infrastructure builds an indoor location-tracking environment.
